claims.statement: Agent middleware provides a composable, layered approach to intercepting and modifying agent behavior at well-defined execution points without changing core agent logic, with handlers registered for lifecycle hooks spanning initialization (before_agent), per-iteration model invocation (before_model, wrap_model_call, after_model), tool execution (wrap_tool_call), and completion (after_agent), composing by wrapping handlers in registration order to enable cross-cutting concerns such as automatic retries, error handling, human-in-the-loop approval, and request/response transformation.
